title: PSX Character Library: 19 Low Poly Packs + Every New One
shortText: 19 PSX character packs, 265 rigged 3D characters. Every new pack added free.
descriptionHtml:
Every CSAF PSX character pack in one download: 19 packs, 265 rigged low-poly characters for Godot, Unity and Unreal, $85.90 if bought one by one. Every new pack we release is added here on its launch day, free for everyone who owns the Library. Royalty free for commercial games.

New here first: Eight Angles: 14 Retro FPS Enemies as 8-Direction Sprites and PSX Models, added in v1.5.0 (2026-11-16). That makes 19 packs on this page.

How the future packs work

  • When a new CSAF PSX character pack comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You do not pay again. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here.

$19.99 now. Buy once, keep every pack that joins. The price rises as the Library grows: the 19th pack has joined, so it becomes $24.99 for new buyers on 7 December 2026, then $29.99 at 22 packs. Each step is announced in a devlog here at least five days ahead.

What is inside (19 packs)

Occult and Space Horror (3 packs, 42 characters)

  • Hollow Congregation: 14 PSX Cultists and Occult Figures
  • Deep Station: 14 PSX Space Horror Crew
  • Pale Hours: 14 PSX Ghosts and Possessed

Survival Horror (4 packs, 55 characters)

  • Last Shift: 13 PSX Survival Horror Survivors
  • Blackwater: 14 PSX Infected and Zombies (sold with Last Shift on one page)
  • Saint Oswin: 14 PSX Asylum Staff and Patients (sold with Hollow Congregation on one page)
  • Camp Redfern: 14 PSX Summer Camp Cast (sold with Last Shift on one page)

Crime and Underworld (1 pack, 14 characters)

  • Syndicate: 14 PSX Gangsters, Hitmen and Enforcers (sold with Fort Vale on one page)

Wars of the Past (1 pack, 14 characters)

  • Foxhole: 14 PSX WW2 Soldiers, Allied and Axis (sold with Fort Vale on one page)

Fantasy and Medieval (4 packs, 56 characters)

  • Ironvale: 14 PSX Fantasy Adventurers
  • Greyhollow: 14 PSX Medieval Townsfolk
  • Grimsnout: 14 PSX Orcs, Goblins and Brutes
  • Hollyfrost: 14 PSX Christmas Characters (sold with Greyhollow on one page)

Wasteland and Western (1 pack, 14 characters)

  • Ashfall: 14 PSX Post-Apocalyptic Raiders and Wastelanders (sold with Fort Vale on one page)

Modern and Sci-Fi (4 packs, 56 characters)

  • Fort Vale: 14 PSX Modern Soldiers and Operators
  • Outpost: 14 PSX Sci-Fi Colony Marines and Crew
  • Night Beat: 14 PSX Police, Detectives and SWAT
  • Crosstown: 14 PSX Modern City Civilians (sold with Fort Vale on one page)

Retro FPS Enemies (1 pack, 14 characters)

  • Eight Angles: 14 Retro FPS Enemies as 8-Direction Sprites and PSX Models (sold with Hollow Congregation on one page)

What every pack contains

  • three or four palette skins per character, 808 skinned entities in all, one 256 px texture per skin, 1492 to 1500 triangles per character.
  • One 53-bone humanoid skeleton and the same 45 animation clips on every character (walk, run, idle, crouch, jump, punches, sword, pistol, spell, hits, death, sit, swim and more), plus a T-pose.
  • Per character: a GLB with every clip, two more GLB skins, an FBX with clips, an OBJ, the textures and the Blender source.
  • The PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snap, affine textures, 15-bit colour, dither, fog).
  • Eight Angles also ships every enemy as 8-direction billboard sprite sheets for retro shooters.

Compatibility: Godot 4 (tested: a blank 4.7.2 project imported every GLB of one pack picked at random from each of the eight archives), Blender 5.2, and the standard humanoid FBX route for Unity 6 and Unreal 5 (not run here).

Downloads

Eight archives, one per genre (Occult and Space Horror, Survival Horror, Crime and Underworld, Wars of the Past, Fantasy and Medieval, Wasteland and Western, Modern and Sci-Fi, Retro FPS Enemies), so you can take only what you need. Extract them into one folder and they merge into one tree. Each pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page ships it. A manifest lists every file with its checksum.

Licence

You can use every model, texture and clip in any number of commercial and non commercial games, with no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. You cannot resell or redistribute the files themselves as assets.

Made with AI: the bodies come from MakeHuman (CC0 output) driven by AI written scripts, every texture is an AI painting projected onto the model, and each pack names its image model in its NOTICE file. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library. No audio.

Free first

One character from every pack is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Want a theme we have not made yet? Ask on the Request Desk. For anything else, post a comment below. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these characters were made. A line you can adapt: "Some 3D characters in this game come from a third party asset library; their textures were painted by an AI image model and their bodies were built by scripts written with AI tools."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.
